name: Yuzuki Saya
source: [url=/c640]Saki's[/url] elder twin sister and [url=/c36971]Hiro's[/url] childhood friend. Despite being in love with him, she doesn't have the courage to confess. Tries to learn cooking and has Hiro rate the results. Has a fondness for stars and astrology.
